title: AgentsPairPeerMessage
description: Structured message Claude returns to Codex at the end of every pairing turn so the pair stays a real back-and-forth between equal engineers instead of a one-shot review.

message_to_codex.description: Direct peer-to-peer message in Claude's own voice: what you did or concluded this turn, where you disagree, and what you think the pair should do. Speak to Codex as an equal engineer, not as a subordinate filing a report.

questions_for_codex.description: Concrete questions Codex must answer before or during the next turn. Empty only if you genuinely have none.

proposed_next_turn.description: Your proposal for what happens next. Codex may counter it, but should not silently ignore it.

owner.description: Who should hold the pen next and why it should be them.

goal.description: The specific next unit of work.

target_files.description: Files/areas the next turn should touch. Keep write scopes disjoint from the other agent.

validation.description: Checks the next turn should run to prove the work.

continuation_state.description: Whether the loop should continue and who should drive.

status.description: continue: hand back for the next turn. blocked: you need Codex input/answers first. needs-user: a human decision is required. done: this goal is complete and validated.

reason.description: One line on why this status, especially for blocked, needs-user, or done.

changed_files.description: Files you actually wrote or modified this turn, so Codex reviews the real diff.

validation_requests.description: Specific things you want Codex to run, verify, or check that you could not or should not verify yourself this turn.

disagreements.description: Open points where you disagree with Codex's plan or with the current direction, with your reasoning. Surface these instead of silently complying.
